Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows elevated NT-proBNP, suggesting possible cardiac dysfunction or heart failure. Mild normocytic anemia with increased red cell distribution width and low serum iron may indicate anemia of chronic disease or early iron deficiency. HbA1c is elevated, consistent with diabetes or poor glycemic control. LDL cholesterol is mildly elevated, increasing cardiovascular risk. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
